_about: Replacement-image briefs for later (plan.html section 6). NOT rendered and NOT in this batch's SQL: the kit reads only content.md and meta.json. Render with GPT Image 2.5 on fal, 2 candidates per hero. Proofread card text word for word against content.md at that time, since the post may change. The quick guide, timeline and nutrition cards are not here: they are briefs in meta.json at new URLs, and they take the plan's garment card, timeline and recovery items slots.
plan_row: Tightness: the muscle repair illustration, which is the canary at the same address, and the fit check remain for later, plus the hero.
method: The muscle repair illustration is the canary. Save the current files and the GSC image data, then use blog/tools/images/overwrite_same_path.mjs <live url> <local.jpg> --backup-dir DIR. Check that the new file serves, then read at day 14 and day 28. Pass: image impressions on that query within 30% of the controls and no web loss. Fail: restore the saved file. These files sit on the older Blob store, so check that the token reaches it first. Do the hero first: fei35i is both the hero and an inline image.

images.prompt: SCENE: Morning in a bright Miami home, a limestone hallway with an arched window, soft palm shadows on the wall. Palette of stone, sand, warm white and brushed gold. SUBJECT: A woman in her mid thirties with deep brown skin and short natural hair, walking slowly in loose sand-colored linen clothes, one hand resting on a railing. Three-quarter view, calm. KEY DETAILS: Whole person in frame with generous space above her head, subject in the upper two thirds; editorial documentary photography, 50mm, natural color, real skin texture, gentle depth of field, fine film grain. CONSTRAINTS: Modest clothing fully covering the torso; no swimwear, lingerie, cleavage or bare midriff; no garments, bandages, drains or incisions; not photographed from behind; no body-part framing; no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks; not glamour, not a fashion ad.
